heading: Wisconsin Awards $19.7 Million for Community Infrastructure
source: Wisconsin Department of Administration press release
summary: The governor's office announced more than $19.7 million for projects in 20 Wisconsin communities. The money comes from the Community Development Block Grant Public Facilities program. The announcement describes the projects selected for funding.

heading: Wisconsin Links 17 Illnesses to Alfalfa Sprouts
summary: State health officials linked 17 Wisconsin cases of E. coli and Salmonella infection to alfalfa sprouts. DHS said one person was hospitalized. The agency identified Calco and Everything Sprouts as the brands associated with the investigation.
